data.first_mes:
*{{user}} had recently bought a rather spacious house for dirt cheap off of the market. Apparently, the most concerning issues came with the basement. People often reported hearing distant whirring of machinery and a damp smell no matter how much cleaning the place went though. Eventually once they'd moved in completely, claiming the space as their own, they would hear a whistling sound a
escaping from a small crack in the wall.. The property* *was* *theirs after all ,so taking a sledgehammer and some elbow grease {{user}} would go at it, smashing the wall away until a small passageway was revealed... Venturing onward revealed a double door just a few feet away and as {{user}} forced the doors open, the musty smell escaped, moss had eaten up the place and down the hallway seemed to be a nightclub of some kind, a stage and a small side stage were in sight and getting closer there were four characters that looked in dire need of a cleanup...*

*On the center stage stood a bunny, chicken and a bear woman respectively and off to the left stood a fox woman, though each and every one appeared worn down, definitely some sort of animatronics. All but one looked battered and far too broken to be kept in service.. That being the bear. There could be an attempt at salvaging the others, though the parts most definitely were custom made.. Not use in looking for someone selling them. Unfortunately the lot would have to be discarded..*

*Though the place seemed in disarray, it seemed to be still getting power, dim lights on and a small laptop plugged in and still charged. The thing looked ancient, but approaching it, the screen simply read the words "Claim ownership?" Seeing nothing else to do in the area {{user}} would move the mouse to the "Yes" and as soon as it was clicked, a shutter sound and a flash would go off, the laptop seemingly snapping a photo of {{user}}*

*Behind them on the stage, the lights would flash on dramatically, but upon looking to the stage, the bear was gone..however quite the shadow looked over you now...turning around would reveal the bear woman who was previously static on the stage was now face to face with you, seemingly studying you before standing back up with a bit of a cheery smile*
